# UI生成提示词

工具：内置image_gen。三个组件各独立生成一次。

## paper-panel

```text
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one production-ready nine-slice paper UI panel sprite for an original cozy hand-painted H5 game.
Primary request: Paint a single complete square sheet of thick creamy paper, seen exactly straight on. Its four corners are gently rounded. The outer silhouette is subtly irregular and hand drawn but neat. The sheet has a very fine honey-brown pencil outline and a shallow layered paper edge.
Style/medium: Warm storybook gouache with natural fine drawing, like a gently sunlit illustrated wooden reading room with honey-colored timber and soft warm plaster. Match that warm hand-painted material language only. Do not draw a room, house, scenery, or any recognizable object from a room.
Materials/color: Warm ivory cream surface, delicate barely visible natural paper fibers. The central area is exceptionally clean and almost uniformly light for readable dark UI text. All paper thickness and rounded-edge detail must stay in the outer 10% of the component so it can be nine-slice stretched. A very faint painted contact shadow just outside the edge.
Composition: Square 1024x1024 canvas, exactly one component, complete square sheet centered, approximately 7% empty transparent margin around all four sides. Front elevation, no perspective or rotation.
Background: TRUE TRANSPARENT PNG with actual alpha outside the sheet and its faint shadow. Do not paint a white background and do not depict a checkerboard.
Text: none. The entire center must be blank.
Avoid: letters, numbers, symbols, icons, flowers, leaves, characters, knots, rivets, corner ornaments, decorations, patterns, old parchment, dirty dark yellow edges, blackened edges, torn or cracked edges, rolled scrolls, strong shadows, photorealistic photography, sterile pure-vector rounded rectangles. One asset only, not a screenshot or an asset sheet.
```

## button-neutral

```text
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one production-ready nine-slice neutral button background sprite for an original cozy hand-painted H5 game.
Primary request: Paint a single horizontal rectangular button seen exactly straight on, body width-to-height about 3:1, with softly rounded corners. Its extremely narrow rim is light honey-colored wood, surrounding a warm pale cream paper center. Add a slight low wooden lower lip for very gentle physical depth.
Style/medium: Original warm storybook gouache with natural fine drawing, like a gently sunlit illustrated wooden reading room with honey-colored timber and soft warm plaster. Match that warm hand-painted material language only. Do not draw a room or scene. Tangible subtle brushwork, soft fine honey-brown drawn outline, no photographic look and no sterile pure vector shape.
Materials/color: Light honey wooden edge with very restrained grain, warm cream paper face. The outer edge takes only around 10% of the button body height. The middle 75% is clean, flat, blank, almost uniformly light. No large grain stripes or decorations. Detail is restrained around the perimeter for nine-slice stretching.
Composition: 1536x1024 transparent canvas. Exactly one complete horizontal 3:1 button centered with ample fully transparent space on every side. Exactly frontal flat elevation, level and unrotated, no isometric perspective. Entire silhouette visible.
Background: TRUE TRANSPARENT PNG with actual alpha outside the button and faint hand-painted contact shadow. Do not paint a background and do not depict a checkerboard.
Text: none. Entire face is empty for code-rendered labels.
Avoid: letters, numbers, text, icons, symbols, flowers, leaves, characters, knots, rivets, corner ornaments, decorative props, strong highlights, thick frame, carved motifs, heavy shadows, full-page UI mockup, asset sheet. One button only.
```
